name: File upload
summary: Drop zone with a real file input, plus File upload items that show the progress and status of each file.
use: Add documents or images to a form or project.
avoid: One small file in a compact form: a normal button with a file input is enough.
anatomy: Drop zone: featured icon, action link, drag text, hint.
File upload item: file icon, name, size, progress, status, remove button.
reactProps: FileUploadItem name / size / progress / status / error / onRemove
behaviour: Clicking opens the file picker. Dragging shows the Drag over state.
Each file gets its own item with progress.
a11y: Works fully without dragging: the action link opens the native file input.
File upload item announces progress and errors with aria-live="polite".
The remove button has a label with the file name.
content: The hint names the file types and maximum size: "PDF, JPG or PNG (max. 10 MB)".
The error message names the cause: "The file is larger than 10 MB."
do: Check the type and size before uploading.
